security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Offline Bangla typing tutor with Avro, Bijoy, Jatiya & heatmap analytics
bundle.longDescription: Standalone offline Bangla Typing Master desktop application for Linux. Supports Avro Phonetic, Bijoy Classic, Bijoy Compatible, National (Jatiya), and Probhat keyboard layouts, customizable character practice, custom lessons, interactive keyboard heatmap, and finger performance analytics with persistent local storage.
